<thought>Based on the most intense ESI peak at m/z 182.0732, the neutral mass is ≈181.0659 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass and the observed isotopic pattern is C₈H₉N₂O₃, which can be written in the required format as C8H9O3N2.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H9O3N2</final_answer>
